Issue-2 authority does not approve those details.

review_items.decision: Accept D2H as exact profile submit/done evidence only, with no inferred request return edge, and fail closed on failure, orphan, duplicate, retry, nonpositive duration or bytes, or identity drift.

Accept transfer_wait as one run/process-scoped point and exact member relation: capture the wait-entry timestamp, enqueue contiguous chunks only after normal return, derive wait_call_observation_id from the first chunk record ID, forbid request fan-out, and do not fabricate a wait duration.

Accept two independent semantic dependencies: SHA-bound Idle Evidence Contract v4.3 for interval, clock, canonicalization, completeness and claim boundaries; and the separately SHA-bound E3 addendum for 0xFFFFFFFF unassigned-stream behavior, per-device completeness, legal point-only zero-duration rows with no interval-bearing universe membership, invalid productive or unknown zero-duration input, and the explicit fail-closed sentinel-plus-point intersection. Acknowledge that audited PR #15 does not yet conform to that intersection and needs executable case-4 conformance. Also accept mapping-level completeness, duplicate suppression, and fail-closed behavior. This does not approve global M0.

Accept content-addressed immutability and gate boundaries; a D2H base span or paired wait interval requires a new version; actual run commits are bound by resolved configuration and joint admission; a new source commit alone does not require a mapping version unless it changes an observation boundary, identity, endpoint, cross-process handoff, D2H/wait mapping, or claim boundary; this approval cannot activate Item 4B, the P0 overlay, communication mode, G1, NPU, service, experiment, performance claim, or M0.
